svg.title: An autonomous trading agent that has never placed a single trade
svg.desc: Social preview card. Headline: an autonomous trading agent that has never placed a single trade — and that's the point. Zero orders submitted by the agent, zero real money at risk ever, 2,000 offline tests with no install. Apache-2.0; two strategy families were predeclared, measured and nulled on their own criteria.
